display-1.from: steered: IA's site loads Benton Sans only at 300, 400, 500 and 700, and its own CSS asks for 600 on page titles and article questions; with no 600 file the browser renders Benton Bold. Setting IA's bold steps to 600 therefore changes nothing where Benton Sans is installed, while Libre Franklin, the free stand-in, renders a true SemiBold. Two independent judges read Libre Franklin 700 at display sizes as Black/ExtraBold beside IA's Benton Bold; 600 matches Benton Bold's colour. (was 700, read from steered: Libre Franklin, the free face that renders wherever Benton Sans is not installed, sets 3.3% narrower than Benton Sans at 700 and 2.4% narrower at 500 (measured on IA's own woff2 in the browser pane). IA's exact tracking (-0.025 to -0.03em) makes the stand-in's bold headings look cramped in the twins; +0.015em at 700 and +0.01em at 500 restores IA's set width.
